quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you the traffic rules you must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you the traffic rules you must follow. This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left-turning vehicles. You cannot use it to pass other cars or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter this road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It means left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely pass or meet a truck. Be careful.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait for the intersection to clear before driving.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Maximum safe speed in a residential area.
Maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
Maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
Maximum safe speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for highway exits. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic from other directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger, all riders should form a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a traffic light ahead. Be ready to stop for red lights, slow for yellow lights, and watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards or unusual conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet. Vehicles are harder to control, so drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is cleaning up trash on the highway.
Workers are on or near the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means workers are in the area. Drive carefully through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic moves in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a merge is coming. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming and you should be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead makes a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead makes a sharp turn at an extreme angle (in this case, to the right). Slow down as much as you would for a sharp turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic only moves one way. Do not enter from the direction you are coming from.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. When you see this sign, slow down and be ready for unusual or dangerous conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you that an island or barrier is ahead. Stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm out straight with palm down, then swings it down, riders behind should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules you must follow. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow background. This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead. Be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic must move on this street. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bikes, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when riding in a group?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders in the group should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther back from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops when turn signals are not working. A left arm extended straight out means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Riders may turn right or go straight.
Riders may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Riders may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, riders must either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right and then left. Slow down so you can safely take these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means that U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign (with an arrow below) shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride near traffic here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Slow down and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging into your lane.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you that traffic from the right will merge into your lane. Be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. Do not turn around at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The fastest safe speed when roads and weather are ideal.
The fastest safe speed in all road and weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest safe speed when roads and weather are ideal.
questions.explanation: The speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road under ideal conditions. You may need to drive slower when weather or road conditions are bad.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road becomes slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is extra slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs mark railroad crossings. This sign tells you that train tracks are ahead. Watch and listen for trains.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue on the freeway or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue on the freeway.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway. You can change lanes to stay on the freeway, or you must exit if you remain in that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road intersects a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you of a T intersection ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging onto the road from the right.

questions.question: What is the main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control. Instead, ease back onto the road gently.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Extend your left arm straight out to signal a left turn or left lane change. You can use hand signals instead of or along with your turn signal.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop and yield to other traffic. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: At a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection go first before you enter.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must obey it. Passing is not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it signals that they will slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: From bottom to top, traffic light colors go in this order:
questions.explanation: Traffic lights go from bottom to top in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you to slow down because the road has many curves.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of colors on a traffic light?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights always have red on top and green on the bottom. When lights are side by side, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The bridge or overpass ahead is low.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge or overpass ahead is low.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass or bridge ahead has low clearance. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot park in this area. Regulation signs show rules that drivers must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive through carefully without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a full stop. You must let other vehicles and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does this mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn right.
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, it means the rider is turning right or moving into the right lane.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, the lead rider uses hand signals to communicate. When the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm up and swings it upward, it tells other riders to go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to move into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that an area with low clearance is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you to an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane use control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Keep driving at the same speed.
Speed up to avoid slowing down traffic.
Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic merge.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering from the side. If the lane next to you is empty, move into it to help traffic merge.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always give way to people crossing in a crosswalk. Watch carefully for pedestrians when you drive through intersections or turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right and shows the safe speed to drive (in this case, 35 mph). Slow down before you reach the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may become slippery when wet. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane will end. All traffic in the right lane must move left to continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show sharp curves. The arrow points in the direction of the curve. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several of these signs placed along the curve.

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be present ahead. Be alert and ready to share the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing on a steep slope. Low-riding vehicles may scrape the bottom or get stuck on the tracks. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up. Slow down and be ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead. Watch for children and be ready to stop.
